page: Microsoft Azure E32ps_v6 is an ARM-based, memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Epsv6 server family. It is powered by 32 dedicated physical cores of the Microsoft Neoverse-N2 ARM processor running at 3.4 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core and no hyperthreading. The system features 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is compatible with Premium Storage.

In benchmark testing, the E32ps_v6 demonstrates strong multi-core processing and exceptional memory subsystem performance. The stress-ng multi-core test and Geekbench multi-core scores are categorized as strong, while the memory bandwidth for both large-block read and write operations ranks in the top tier. Passmark memory and database operations also achieve top-tier ratings, reflecting highly efficient memory access speeds and data handling capabilities. However, single-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench is average, and large-scale LLM inference tasks show poor throughput, highlighting a performance tradeoff for heavy single-threaded or massive AI workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E32ps_v6 offers a high-density memory profile on an ARM architecture, which typically translates to lower power consumption and better resource-to-cost ratios compared to traditional x86 memory-optimized instances. Given its high memory bandwidth, strong multi-core execution, and top-tier database operation benchmarks, this server is highly suited for memory-intensive workloads, relational databases, caching layers, and high-throughput web serving.
